tokens.name: brand-purple
tokens.usage: The MDLR purple. Canonical brand value: logo, the website's meta theme-color, purple bands of matedansleretro.fr. Identical in the three themes — never re-tint it. For a screen background, use surface-base (which equals this purple in the arcade theme).

tokens.name: brand-pink
tokens.usage: The MDLR pink, signature color of the "mate" logo and of the website's pink bands. Identical in the three themes. As a fill: surface-accent. As text, only at 24px+ or bold 19px+ (4.16:1 on surface-base in arcade) — otherwise use ink-accent.

tokens.name: brand-slate
tokens.usage: The slate blue of the diagonal band in the logo. Reserved for the logo and reproductions of the RÉTRO block. Do not use it as a surface or as text.

tokens.name: surface-base
tokens.usage: Page background. Carries ink-primary, ink-secondary, ink-muted and ink-accent. In scene, deliberately deeper than the brand purple: a projector lifts blacks and crushes shadows.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed background: gutters between cards, progress bar tracks, empty table areas. Carries ink-primary and ink-secondary.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and table rows on top of surface-base. Arcade value taken from the bracket background of the Tournaments app. Carries ink-primary, ink-secondary, ink-muted and ink-accent.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating elements above a card: modals, menus, tooltips, sticky table headers. Carries ink-primary and ink-secondary.

tokens.name: surface-accent
tokens.usage: The solid pink band: the website's alternating sections, app bar, primary buttons. Carries ink-on-accent. Never put white body text under 24px on it.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Surface inverted relative to the theme: pixel panels of brackets in arcade, solid inserts in console. Carries ink-inverse.

tokens.name: ink-primary
tokens.usage: Main text and headings, on surface-base, surface-sunken, surface-raised and surface-overlay (≥ 11.7:1 in the three themes).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, card descriptions, field labels, on surface-base and surface-raised (≥ 9.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Incidental text: captions, input hints, timestamps, on surface-base and surface-raised (≥ 5.7:1). Do not go below 12px with this color.

tokens.name: ink-accent
tokens.usage: Pink text and icons readable at any size: links, section titles, winner's name, on surface-base and surface-raised (≥ 5.4:1). This is the text version of brand-pink, which only passes at 24px+.

tokens.name: ink-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-accent (4.53:1 in arcade and console, 5.28:1 in scene). The website currently puts #331655 on the pink: 4.16:1, only valid for 24px+ headings — this token is the version that passes at any size.

tokens.name: ink-on-accent-large
tokens.usage: White on the pink band as the website uses it: 3.64:1, so reserved for 24px+ or bold 19px+ headings and lines of at least 3px. Brand value kept as is; for body text on pink, use ink-on-accent.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse: player names in the white pixel panels of brackets (15:1).

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative separators: rules between list rows, bottom of table headers. Purely decorative, carries no information.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Meaningful outlines: borders of fields and checkboxes, frames of pixel panels (≥ 3.69:1 on surface-base and surface-raised).

tokens.name: line-accent
tokens.usage: The pink outline around a match block, an active tab or a selected card. At least border-thick to stay visible.

tokens.name: grid-dot
tokens.usage: Square of the background pixel pattern (mdlr-pixelgrid class). Deliberately ~1.2:1 against the background: it is a texture, never an information carrier.

tokens.name: grid-dot-bright
tokens.usage: Second square of the pixel pattern, for the irregular density of tournament bands. Mix with grid-dot, never used alone.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, solid, 3px, with a 2px offset. Chosen to pass 3:1 on every surface of the theme, pink band included (3.13:1 minimum).

tokens.name: state-live-surface
tokens.usage: Background of the "En cours" (live) pill. Exact value from the Tournaments app. Identical in the three themes: the pill stays light to stand out on the purple.

tokens.name: state-live-ink
tokens.usage: Text and dot of the "En cours" pill, on state-live-surface (6.41:1).

tokens.name: state-soon-surface
tokens.usage: Background of the "À venir" (upcoming) pill. Exact value from the Tournaments app.

tokens.name: state-soon-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the "À venir" pill, on state-soon-surface (6.38:1).

tokens.name: state-done-surface
tokens.usage: Background of the "Terminé" (finished) pill.

tokens.name: state-done-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the "Terminé" pill, on state-done-surface (7.54:1).

tokens.name: state-bye-surface
tokens.usage: Background of the "Qualifié d'office" (bye) pill of a player exempt from a round. Added by the system: the Tournaments app currently uses a green, the same register as "En cours", which makes one color carry two different meanings.

tokens.name: state-bye-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the "Qualifié d'office" pill, on state-bye-surface (6.86:1). On the blue axis, so distinguishable from the "En cours" green, including with red-green color blindness.

tokens.name: state-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions: "Vider" (clear) button, deleting a player. Exact value from the Tournaments app. Carries white as a fill (4.28:1, so buttons in bold 16px minimum).

tokens.name: state-pending-surface
tokens.usage: Background of bracket slots not played yet, under state-pending-ink (6.37:1 in arcade and scene, 5.82:1 in console). Deliberately darker than the Tournaments app's #7a7a7b, on which no text can reach 4.5:1: it is a filler gray, not a brand color.

tokens.name: state-pending-ink
tokens.usage: Text of a pending slot, on state-pending-surface. White in the three themes: the filler gray does not change with the theme, so neither does its ink. Using ink-primary instead would fail at 2.84:1 in the light theme.

tokens.name: rank-gold
tokens.usage: 1st place: RankBadge plate and podium step. Exact value from the podium screen, identical in the three themes — it is a metal, it is not re-tinted. Always carries ink-on-accent (8.57:1).

tokens.name: rank-silver
tokens.usage: 2nd place. Exact value from the podium screen, identical in the three themes. Carries ink-on-accent (6.31:1).

tokens.name: rank-bronze
tokens.usage: 3rd place. Exact value from the podium screen, identical in the three themes. Carries ink-on-accent (5.35:1).

tokens.name: rank-gold-hi
tokens.usage: Light highlight of gold, top of the metallic gradient of the RankBadge and podium steps. Never used alone: always in a gradient toward rank-gold.

tokens.name: rank-silver-hi
tokens.usage: Light highlight of silver, same use as rank-gold-hi.

tokens.name: rank-bronze-hi
tokens.usage: Light highlight of bronze, same use as rank-gold-hi.

families.sans: Montserrat, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Single page title. Exact value from styles.css (3rem/3.5rem). On the website, always uppercase; in apps, sentence case.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Website band title (2rem/2.5rem). Uppercase, centered, ink-accent on purple and ink-on-accent on pink.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Subsection title (1.5rem/2rem). Threshold from which brand-pink can be used as text.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Title of program and practical info cards (1.25rem/1.75rem). It is the website's column title.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Short block title (1rem/1.5rem), in a dense card or an app panel.

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: Smallest heading of the website's scale (0.875rem/1.25rem). Below that, use eyebrow.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase overline above a statistic value. In ink-muted or ink-accent. Added by the system: the website does not have this level.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Plus de 25 consoles en accès libre.
styles.usage: Website body text (1.125rem/1.5rem, exact value from styles.css). Deliberately tight line height: do not loosen it, it is the brand's rhythm.

styles.name: body-semibold
styles.usage: Medium emphasis, the website's .medium / .semibold class. Also used for section links.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Strong emphasis: dates, times, prices. It is the website's b / .bold, at 800 not 700. Replaces italics, which the brand reserves for side notes.

styles.name: body-italic
styles.usage: Parenthetical note, like free entry for under-8s. The only use of italics in the brand.

styles.name: body-ui
styles.sample: Ajoutez les joueurs avant de démarrer.
styles.usage: Body text of management interfaces. Added by the system: 18px is too generous for a dense admin screen. Do not use it on the website.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense text: input hints, table cells. Uses the metrics of the website's h6.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and notes, in ink-muted. The system's minimum size, added to the website's scale.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Figures read at a glance: sign-up counter, score, timer. Monospaced so the digits do not jump during an update.

styles.name: arcade-hero
styles.usage: Title of a full-frame game screen: podium, waiting screen. One per screen.

styles.name: arcade-title
styles.usage: Arcade section title: "QUARTS DE FINALE", "TOP 10". In ink-accent or brand-pink.

styles.name: arcade-name
styles.usage: Player name in a bracket, a podium or a score table. Minimum size: below it the pixel font closes up.

styles.name: arcade-label
styles.usage: Short uppercase label in an arcade frame. Three words max.

styles.name: scene-hero
styles.usage: Projected title, readable at 10 m. Reserved for the scene theme.

styles.name: scene-row
styles.usage: Leaderboard or bracket row on a big screen. Absolute minimum when projected.

styles.name: scene-meta
styles.usage: Projected secondary information. In ink-secondary, never ink-muted on a projector.

styles.name: scene-pixel
styles.usage: Projected pixel title. Below this, the display font loses its counters on a screen.

spacing.note: 4px scale. MDLR products are built on a 4px grid, consistent with the brand's pixel art: every value must be a multiple of space-1.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Resets an inherited margin.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label, thickness of an inner outline. Base unit of the grid.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inner spacing of a pill, gap between two player rows in a match block.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical button padding, gutter of a dense list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal button and field padding, default gutter — and side of the website's decorative square (.decorative-square is 1rem).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a compact card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a standard card, gap between two cards of the same grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks of the same section, modal padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between the blocks of a website band (the sections' gap-10) and gutter between columns of a management screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top padding of a website section band (3rem in styles.css).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Side padding of a website section band (4rem in styles.css).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Breathing room between two website sections on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of a website section band (6rem in styles.css) — and edge margin in the scene theme, where a projection loses its edges.

radius.note: Two deliberate registers: radius-none for everything pixel art (brackets, arcade panels), the rounded scale for management interfaces.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Pixel register: bracket panels, podium blocks, background pattern squares, arcade frames. A rounded corner breaks the 8-bit illusion.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small thumbnails, square pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Input fields, dropdowns, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and list rows of the Tournaments app.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and panels of management screens, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: State pills, counters, fully rounded app bar buttons.

shadow.note: In the arcade and scene themes, depth comes from a hard offset without blur — a blurred shadow on a saturated purple background reads as a smudge. Blur is only used in the console theme.

tokens.name: shadow-pixel
tokens.usage: Hard drop shadow of bracket panels, podium blocks and arcade frames. Always a multiple of space-1.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Subtle elevation of a card on surface-base.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Modals and floating menus, to lift surface-overlay off the content behind.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring applied as a box-shadow, set with a 2px offset on the element.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control. Always paired with aria-disabled: opacity alone does not meet the contrast threshold.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind a modal, over a surface-sunken fill.

tokens.name: opacity-grid
tokens.usage: Opacity of the pixel pattern when it goes over an image or an event poster.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Separators in line-subtle and field borders in the console theme.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Meaningful borders: field in error, active tab, outline of a selected card.

tokens.name: border-pixel
tokens.usage: Frame of bracket panels and arcade blocks, in line-accent or line-strong. Minimum thickness to hold up when projected.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Normal flow content.

tokens.name: z-grid
tokens.usage: Background pixel pattern, behind its container's content.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table header, bracket toolbar.

tokens.name: z-appbar
tokens.usage: App bar.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim and modals.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Notifications, above everything else.

layout.note: Widths taken from the website. The first four are the Tailwind breakpoints the website actually uses; the next three are content widths hard-coded in its template.

tokens.name: layout-sm
tokens.usage: Footer photo thumbnail grid (max-w-screen-sm).

tokens.name: layout-lg
tokens.usage: Reading width of a section band: intro text and column grids (max-w-screen-lg).

tokens.name: layout-xl
tokens.usage: Width of the decorative squares layer, wider than the content (max-w-screen-xl).

tokens.name: layout-column
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a program or practical info column. Three columns per band at most.

tokens.name: layout-thumb
tokens.usage: Footer photo thumbnail, in radius-xl.

tokens.name: layout-prose
tokens.usage: Narrow centered text block, like the call to follow the Instagram account.

tokens.name: layout-logo
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the logo in the website header. Minimum: 160px.
